companyIntro.name: Landmark Realty Partners
companyIntro.mission: Invest in and manage property with discipline on income, risk and tenants.
companyIntro.culture: Underwrite conservatively, collect rent on time, fix what matters first.

projectBackground.name: Residential Block Management — Parkside Court
projectBackground.context: Arrears are rising and repairs are slow. The owner wants a grip on collections and maintenance.

manager.name: Daniel Reeves
manager.role: Head of Asset Management, Landmark Realty Partners
manager.note: Collect early, fix fast, communicate kindly and in writing.

assignment.title: Stabilise the block
assignment.brief: Calculate occupancy and collections, price vacancy, prioritise repairs, build the rent roll in Excel and write an arrears letter.

documents.name: Rent Roll
documents.note: Three units with partial or no payment.

tasks.title: Occupancy
tasks.prompt: 46 of 50 units are occupied. What is occupancy (%)?
tasks.mistake: Counting leased but vacant units overstates it.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Collection Rate
tasks.prompt: Rent due 80,000; collected 74,400. What is the collection rate (%)?
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Lost Rent
tasks.prompt: A unit rented at 1,500 a month is vacant for 45 days (30-day month). What is the lost rent?
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Emergency Repairs
tasks.prompt: Select repairs that must be treated as emergencies.
tasks.mistake: Treating all requests alike delays the urgent ones.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Rent Roll (Excel)
tasks.prompt: Balance in column D = rent due - paid.
tasks.mistake: Aggregating hides which units are late.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Arrears Letter
tasks.prompt: Write a 3-5 sentence polite arrears letter.
tasks.modelAnswer: Dear tenant, our records show a balance of 800 outstanding on your rent for this month. We understand circumstances can change, so please contact us by Friday to arrange payment or discuss a plan. If we do not hear from you, we will have to follow the formal arrears process set out in your lease. Thank you for your prompt attention.
tasks.reasoning: A good letter states the amount, offers help, sets a date and the next step.
tasks.mistake: Threats without an offer escalate conflict.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

caseStudy.title: Case Study: The Slow Boiler
caseStudy.background: A boiler failure was logged as routine and fixed after nine days. Tenants withheld rent and the owner lost two months of income.
caseStudy.solution: Landmark introduced triage categories and on-call cover.
